newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek gets option to buy Unitron.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek gets option to buy Unitron.

text.p: Sabratek Corp, a medical systems company, said Monday it has entered into an option agreement to acquire Unitron Medical Communications Inc in the future at a price based on Unitron's operating results.
Sabratek also said it signed an exclusive technology licensing agreement with Unitron, a clinical patient information systems company.

Under the agreement, Sabratek will pay up to $7 million over 15 years to combine its medical device and data management telemedicine software with Unitron's clinical patient information management network, the company said.
Sabratek shares were up 1/8 at 27-3/4 Monday.
